insights: RH formally defined as: all non-trivial zeros in 0 < Re(s) < 1 have Re(s) = 1/2
PNT zero-free region (Re(s) ≥ 1, Mathlib) proven; RH extends this to 1/2 < Re(s) < 1
Functional equation gives zero symmetry s ↔ 1-s; uses riemannZeta_one_sub from Mathlib
Von Koch 1901: RH ↔ |π(x)-Li(x)| = O(√x log x); needs explicit formula (axiomatized)
Littlewood 1914: error is Ω(√x log log log x), showing √x is the right exponent
mathlibGaps: Explicit formula ψ(x) = x - Σ_ρ x^ρ/ρ + ... not in Mathlib → von Koch axiomatized
Backlund zero-counting N(T) ~ (T/2π) log(T/2π) needs contour integration → axiomatized
Littlewood omega result needs oscillation theory for L-functions → axiomatized
